articles.headline: Sayvia Sellers has 17 points and 7 assists, No. 16 Washington women beat Pacific 75-54
articles.description: — Sayvia Sellers had 17 points and seven assists, Avery Howell scored 12 of her 15 points in the second half, and No. 16 Washington pulled away in the fourth quarter to beat Pacific 75-54 on Thursday night.
